high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from ndtv.com, a news website. The page features an article about Geoffrey Hinton, a British-Canadian computer scientist known as the "Godfather of AI." The article discusses his recent interview on the "Diary of a CEO" podcast, which aired on June 16. In the interview, Hinton expressed serious concerns about the future of artificial intelligence (AI). He warned that AI could eventually surpass humans at virtually everything, leading to mass job loss.
